originalTitle: Wall Street sinks as bond yields rise, Walmart results disappoint
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes closed lower on Thursday, with the Dow tumbling about one-and-a-third percent, the S&P 500 falling just under one percent and the Nasdaq shedding one percent. Rising Treasury yields dented risk appetite, explains Chatham Financial Chairman Amol Dhargalkar. "The sell-off we're seeing is, again, related to what we're seeing in the bond market. There's concern over rising yields, there's concern over fiscal sustainability for the U.S. government. It is bleeding into equity markets. When you compare the two, though, it's clear that even though today there's some correlation, over the last several months, we've seen all-time highs in equity markets. It's been driven by higher earnings expectations. It's been driven by the AI trade. Even though it's a bifurcated equity market, you're seeing, I would say, somewhat broad-based growth over the last several months as you look at different indices." Still, shares of Walmart fell more than 9% after the retail bellwether missed Wall Street expectations for quarterly comparable sales as rising gasoline prices had shoppers reining in spending. Rival retailers Costco, Dollar Tree and Albertsons followed Walmart lower. Shares of Coty dropped more than 9% after the CoverGirl cosmetics brand owner forecast current-quarter earnings below expectations and withheld its annual outlook. :: Archive And shares of Advance Auto Parts tumbled more than 24% after the company issued a weaker annual sales forecast. :: Archive Meanwhile, cryptocurrency-related companies rallied a day after President Donald Trump called on Congress to pass a crypto bill. Shares of Strategy and exchange operator Coinbase Global each gained almost 8%.

chineseTitle: 债券收益率上升，华尔街下跌，沃尔玛业绩令人失望
chineseSummary: 故事：华尔街主要股指周四收低，其中道指下跌约三分之一，标准普尔 500 指数跌幅略低于百分之一，纳斯达克指数下跌百分之一。查塔姆金融公司董事长阿莫尔·达加尔卡 (Amol Dhargalkar) 解释说，国债收益率上升削弱了风险偏好。 “我们看到的抛售再次与我们在债券市场看到的情况有关。人们担心收益率上升，人们担心美国政府的财政可持续性。它正在渗透到股市。不过，当你比较两者时，很明显，尽管今天存在一些相关性，但在过去几个月里，我们看到股市创下历史新高。这是由更高的盈利预期推动的。这是由人工智能交易推动的。尽管这是一个分裂的股票市场，但我想说，当你观察不同的指数时，你会看到过去几个月的基础广泛的增长。”尽管如此，零售领头羊沃尔玛的季度可比销售额未达到华尔街预期，因为汽油价格上涨导致购物者控制支出，导致该公司股价下跌超过 9%。竞争对手零售商 Costco、Dollar Tree 和 Albertsons 跟随沃尔玛走低。 CoverGirl 化妆品品牌所有者预测本季度盈利低于预期并取消年度展望后，Coty 股价下跌逾 9%。 :: Archive 在Advance Auto Parts 发布较弱的年度销售预测后，其股价下跌超过24%。 :: Archive 与此同时，在唐纳德·特朗普总统呼吁国会通过加密货币法案的第二天，加密货币相关公司纷纷上涨。 Strategy 和交易所运营商 Coinbase Global 的股价均上涨近 8%。
